ja540:1.1: Ko nu maṃ usunā vijjhi pamattaṃ udahārakaṃ, khattiyo brāhmaṇo vesso ko maṃ viddhā nilīyasīti.
ja540:2.1: Na me maṃsāni khajjāni, cammen' attho na vijjati, atha kena nu vaṇṇena viddheyyaṃ maṃ amaññathā 'ti
ja540:3.1: Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ, puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kiṃ maṃ viddhā nilīyasīti āha.
ja540:4.1: Rājāhaṃ asmi Kāsīnaṃ, Piliyakkho ti maṃ vidū, lobhā raṭṭhaṃ pahatvāna migam esañ carām' ahaṃ.
ja540:5.1: Issatthe c' asmi kusalo daḷhadhammo ti vissuto, nāgo pi me na muñceyya āgato usupātanan
ja540:6.1: ti. Tvañ ca kassa vā putto si, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ, pituno attano cāpi nāmagottaṃ pavedayā 'ti.
ja540:7.1: Nesādaputto, bhaddan te, Sāmo iti maṃ ñātayo āmantayiṃsu jīvantaṃ, sv-ājj' ev' ahaṃ gato saye.
ja540:8.1: Viddho 'smi puthusallena savisena yathā migo, sakamhi lohite rāja passa semi paripluto.
ja540:9.1: Paṭicamma gataṃ sallaṃ passa vihāmi lohitaṃ, āturo ty-ānupucchāmi: kiṃ maṃ viddhā nilīyasi.
ja540:10.1: Ajinamhi haññate dīpī, nāgo dantehi haññati, atha kena nu vaṇṇena viddheyyaṃ mam amaññathā 'ti.
ja540:11.1: Migo upaṭṭhito āsi āgato usupātanaṃ, taṃ disvā ubbijji Sāma, na te kodho mam āvisīti.
ja540:12.1: Yato sarāmi attānaṃ yato patto 'smi viññutaṃ na maṃ migā uttasānti araññe sāpadāni pi.
ja540:13.1: Yato nidhiṃ parihariṃ yato patto 'smi yobbanaṃ na maṃ migā uttasanti araññe sāpadāni pi.
ja540:14.1: Bhīrū kimpurisā rāja pabbate Gandhamādane sammodamānā gacchāma pabbatāni vanāni ca,
ja540:15.1: atha kena nu vaṇṇena utrase so migo maman ti.
ja540:16.1: Na t' addasā migo Sāma kin t' āham alikaṃ bhaṇe, kodhalobhābhibhūto 'haṃ, usuṃ te taṃ avissajīti. Kuto
ja540:17.1: nu samma āgamma kassa vā pahito tuvaṃ udahāro nadiṃ gaccha āgato Migasammatan ti.
ja540:18.1: Andhā mātāpitā mayhaṃ, te bharāmi brahāvane, tes' āham udahārako āgato Migasammatan ti.
ja540:19.1: Atthi nesaṃ usāmattaṃ atha sāhassa jīvitaṃ, udakassa cālābhena maññe andhā marissare.
ja540:20.1: Na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ, labbhā pi pumunā idaṃ, yañ ca ammaṃ na passāmi, tam me dukkhataraṃ ito.
ja540:21.1: Na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ, labbhā hi pumunā idaṃ, yañ ca tātaṃ na passāmi, tam me dukkhataraṃ ito.
ja540:22.1: Sā nūna kapaṇā ammā cirarattāya rucchiti addharatte va ratte vā nadīva avasucchati.
ja540:23.1: So nūna kapaṇo tāto cirarattāya rucchiti aḍḍharatte va ratte vā nadīva avasucchati.
ja540:24.1: Uṭṭhānapāricariyāya pādasambāhanassa ca Sāma tāta vilapantā hiṇḍissanti brahāvane.
ja540:25.1: Idaṃ dutiyakaṃ sallaṃ kampeti hadayaṃ mama yañ ca andhe na passāmi yañ ca hessāmi jīvitan ti.
ja540:26.1: Mā bāḷhaṃ paridevesi Sāma kalyāṇadassana, ahaṃ kammakaro hutvā bhariyassan te brahāvane.
ja540:27.1: Issatthe c' asmi kusalo daḷhadhammo ti vissuto ahaṃ kammakaro hutvā bhariyassan te brahāvane.
ja540:28.1: Migānaṃ vighāsam anvesaṃ vanamūlaphalāni ca ahaṃ kammakaro hutvā bhariyassan te brahāvane.
ja540:29.1: Kataman taṃ vanaṃ Sāma yattha mātāpitā tava, ahan te tathā bharissaṃ yathā te abhari tuvan ti.
ja540:30.1: Ayaṃ ekapadī rāja yo 'yaṃ ussīsake mama, ito gantvā aḍḍhakosaṃ tattha tesaṃ agārakaṃ, tattha mātāpitā mayhaṃ, te bharassu ito gato ti.
ja540:31.1: Namo te Kāsirāj' atthu, namo te Kāsivaddhana, andhā mātāpitā mayhaṃ, te bharassu brahāvane.
ja540:32.1: Añjalin te pagaṇhāmi, Kāsirāja nam' atthu te, mātaraṃ pitaraṃ mayhaṃ vutto vajjāsi vandanan
ja540:33.1: ti. Idaṃ vatvāna so Sāmo yuvā {kalyāṇadassano} mucchito visavegena visaññī samapajjathā 'ti.
ja540:34.1: Sa rājā parideyesi bahuṃ kāruññasaṃhitaṃ: ajarāmaro 'haṃ āsiṃ, ajj' etaṃ ñāmi no pure. Sāmaṃ kālakataṃ disvā n' atthi maccussa nāgamo,
ja540:35.1: y' assu maṃ patimanteti sa visena samappito Sv-ājj' evaṃ gate kāle na kiñci-m-abhibhāsati,
ja540:36.1: nirayaṃ nūna gacchāmi, ettha me n' atthi saṃsayo, Tadā hi pakataṃ pāpaṃ cirarattāya kibbisaṃ
ja540:37.1: bhavanti tassa vattāro, gāme kibbisakarakaṃ araññe nimmanussamhi ko maṃ vattum arahati.
ja540:38.1: Sārayanti hi kammāni gāme saṃgaccha māṇavā, araññe nimmanussamhi ko maṃ sārayissatīti.
ja540:39.1: Sā devatā antarahitā pabbate Gandhamādane rañño va anukampāya imā gāthā abhāsatha:
ja540:40.1: Āguṃ kari mahārāja akari kamma dukkaṭaṃ, adūsakā pitāputtā tayo ekūsunā hatā.
ja540:41.1: Ehi taṃ anusikkhāmi yathā te sugati siyā: dhammen' andhe vane posa maññe 'haṃ sugatiṃ tayā ti.
ja540:42.1: Sa rājā paridevitvā bahuṃ kāruññasaṃhitaṃ udakakumbham ādāya pakkāmi dakkhiṇāmukho ti.
ja540:43.1: Kassa [nu] eso padasaddo manussass' eva āgato, n' eso Sāmassa nigghoso, ko nu tvam asi mārisa.
ja540:44.1: Santaṃ hi Sāmo vajati, santaṃ pādāni neyati, n' eso Sāmassa nigghoso, ko nu tvam asi mārisā 'ti.
ja540:45.1: Rājāham asmi Kāsīnaṃ Piliyakkho ti maṃ vidū, lobhā raṭṭhaṃ pahatvāna migam esaṃ carām' ahaṃ.
ja540:46.1: Issatthe c' asmi kusalo daḷhadhammo ti vissuto, nāgo pi me na muñceyya āgato usupātanan ti.
ja540:47.1: Svāgatan te mahārāja atho te adurāgataṃ, (V 323|29) issaro pi anuppatto yam idh' atthi pavedaya.
ja540:48.1: Tiṇḍukāni piyālāni madhuke kāsumāriyo phalāni khuddakappāni bhuñja rāja varaṃ varaṃ.
ja540:49.1: Idam pi pānīyaṃ sītaṃ ābhataṃ girigabbharā, tato piva mahārāja sace tvaṃ abhikaṃkhasīti.
ja540:50.1: Nālam andhā vane daṭṭhuṃ, ko nu vo phalam āhari, anandhass' evāyaṃ sammā nivāpo mayhaṃ khāyatīti.
ja540:51.1: Daharo yuvā nātibrahā Sāmo kalyāṇadassano, dīgh' assa kesā asitā atho sunaggavellitā,
ja540:52.1: So have phalam āhatvā ito ādā kamaṇḍaluṃ nadiṃ gato udahāro, maññe na dūram āgato ti.
ja540:53.1: Ahan taṃ avadhiṃ Sāmaṃ yo tuyhaṃ paricārako yaṃ kumāraṃ pavedetha Sāmaṃ kalyāṇadassanaṃ.
ja540:54.1: Dīgh' assa kesā asitā atho sunaggavellitā, tesu lohitalittesu seti Sāmo mayā hato ti.
ja540:55.1: Kena Dukūla mantesi hato Sāmo ti vādinā, hato Sāmo ti sutvāna hadayaṃ me pavedhati.
ja540:56.1: Assatthasseva taruṇaṃ pavālaṃ māluteritaṃ hato Sāmo ti sutvāna hadayam me pavedhatīti.
ja540:57.1: Pārike Kāsirājāyaṃ so Sāmaṃ Migasammate kodhasā usunā vijjhi, tassa mā pāpam icchimhā 'ti.
ja540:58.1: Kicchā laddho piyo putto yo andhe abharī vane taṃ ekaputtaṃ ghātimhi kathaṃ cittaṃ na kopaye ti.
ja540:59.1: Kicchā laddho piyo putto yo andhe abharī vane taṃ ekaputtaṃ ghātimhi akkodhaṃ āhu paṇḍitā ti.
ja540:60.1: Mā bālhaṃ paridevetha hato Sāmo ti vādinā, ahaṃ kammakaro hutvā bharissāmi brahāvane.
ja540:61.1: Issatthe c' asmi kusalo daḷhadhammo ti vissuto, ahaṃ kammakaro hutvā bharissāmi brahāvane.
ja540:62.1: Migānaṃ vighāsam anvesaṃ vanamūlaphalāni ca ahaṃ kammakaro hutvā bharissāmi brahāvane ti.
ja540:63.1: N' eso dhammo mahārāja, n' etaṃ amhesu kappati, rājā tvam asi amhākaṃ, pāde vandāma te mayan ti.
ja540:64.1: Dhammaṃ nesādā bhaṇatha, kato apacitī tayā, pitā tvam asi asmākaṃ, mātā tvam asi Pārike ti.
ja540:65.1: Namo te Kāsirāj' atthu, namo te Kāsivaddhana, añjalin te paggaṇhāma yāva Sām' ānupāpaya.
ja540:66.1: Tassa pāde pavaṭṭantā mukhañ ca bhujadassanaṃ saṃsumbhamānā attānaṃ kālam āgamayāmase ti.
ja540:67.1: Brahāvāḷamigākiṇṇaṃ ākāsantaṃ padissati yattha Sāmo hato seti Cando va patito chamā.
ja540:68.1: Brahāvāḷamigākiṇṇaṃ ākāsantaṃ padissati yattha Sāmo hato seti Suriyo va patito chamā.
ja540:69.1: Brahāvāḷamigākiṇṇaṃ ākāsantaṃ padissati yattha Sāmo hato seti paṃsunā patikuṇṭhito.
ja540:70.1: Brahāvāḷamigākiṇṇaṃ ākāsantaṃ padissati yattha Sāmo hato seti idh' eva vasath' assame it.
ja540:71.1: Yadi tattha sahassāni satāni nahutāni ca n' ev' amhākaṃ bhayaṃ koci vane vāḷesu vijjatīti.
ja540:72.1: Tato andhānam ādāya Kāsirājā brahāvane hatthe gahetvā pakkāmi yattha Sāmo hato ahū 'ti.
ja540:73.1: Disvāna patitaṃ Sāmaṃ puttakaṃ paṃsukuṇḍitaṃ apaviddhaṃ brahāraññe Candaṃ va patitaṃ chamā
ja540:74.1: Disvāna patitaṃ Sāmaṃ puttakaṃ paṃsukuṇḍitaṃ apaviddhaṃ brahāraññe Suriyaṃ va patitaṃ chamā
ja540:75.1: Disvāna patitaṃ Sāmaṃ puttakaṃ paṃsukuṇḍitaṃ apaviddhaṃ brahāraññe karuṇaṃ paridevayuṃ.
ja540:76.1: Disvāna patitaṃ Sāmaṃ puttakaṃ paṃsukuṇḍitaṃ bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ: adhammo kira bho iti.
ja540:78.1: Bāḷhaṃ kho si pamatto Sāma kalyāṇadassana yo ajj' evaṃ gate kāle na kiñci-m-abhibhāsasi.
ja540:79.1: Bāḷhaṃ kho si kuddho Sāma kalyāṇadassana yo ajj' evaṃ gate kāle na kiñci-m-abhibhāsasi.
ja540:80.1: Bāḷhaṃ kho si ditto Sāma kalyāṇadassana yo ajj' evaṃ gate kāle na kiñci-m-abhibhāsasi.
ja540:81.1: Bāḷhaṃ kho si vimano Sāma kalyāṇadassana yo ajj' evaṃ gate kāle na kiñci-m-abhibhāsasi.
ja540:82.1: Jaṭaṃ vaḷīnaṃ paṃkagataṃ ko dāni saṇṭhapessati, Sāmo ayaṃ kālakato andhānaṃ paricārako.
ja540:83.1: Ko ve sammajjan' ādāya sammajjissati assamaṃ, Sāmo ayaṃ kālakato andhānaṃ paricārako.
ja540:84.1: Ko dāni nahāpayissati sīten' uṇhodakena ca, Sāmo ayaṃ kālakato andhānaṃ paricārako.
ja540:85.1: Ko dāni bhuñjayissati vanamūlaphalāni ca, Sāmo ayaṃ kālakato andhānaṃ paricārako ti.
ja540:86.1: Disvāna patitaṃ Sāmaṃ puttakaṃ paṃsukuṇṭhitaṃ aṭṭitā puttasokena mātā saccam abhāsatha:
ja540:87.1: Yena saccen' ayaṃ Sāmo dhammacārī pure ahu etena saccavajjena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatu.
ja540:88.1: Yena saccen' ayaṃ Sāmo brahmacārī pure ahu etena saccavajjena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatu.
ja540:97.1: Yena saccen' ayaṃ Sāmo saccavādī pure ahu etena saccavajjena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatu.
ja540:98.1: Yena saccen' ayaṃ Sāmo mātāpettibharo ahu etena saccavajjena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatu.
ja540:99.1: Yena saccen' ayaṃ Sāmo kule jeṭṭhāpacāyiko etena saccavajjena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatu.
ja540:100.1: Yena saccen' ayaṃ Sāmo pāṇā piyataro mama etena saccavajjena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatu.
ja540:101.1: Yaṃ kiñc' atthi kataṃ puññaṃ mayhañ c' eva pitu-cca te sabbena tena kusalena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatū 'ti. Disvāna patitaṃ Sāmaṃ puttakaṃ
ja540:103.1: Pabbaty-āhaṃ Gandhamādane cirarattanivāsinī, na me piyataro koci añño Sāmā na vijjati, etena saccavajjena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatu.
ja540:104.1: Sabbe vanā gandhamayā pabbate Gandhamādane, etena saccavajjena visaṃ Sāmassa haññatu.
ja540:105.1: Tesaṃ lālappamānānaṃ bahuṃ kāruññasaṃhitaṃ khippaṃ Sāmo samuṭṭhāsi yuvā kalyāṇadassano ti.
ja540:106.1: Sāmo 'ham asmi, bhaddaṃ vo, sotthin' amhi samuṭṭhito, mā bāḷhaṃ paridevetha, mañjunābhivadetha man ti.
ja540:107.1: Svāgatan te mahārāja atho te {adurāgataṃ}, (V 323|29) issaro si anuppatto, yaṃ idh' atthi pavedaya:
ja540:108.1: Tiṇḍukāni piyālāni madhuke kāsumāriyo (= 85|26) phalāni khuddakappāni bhuñja rāja varaṃ varaṃ.
ja540:109.1: Atthi me pānīyaṃ sītaṃ ābhataṃ girigabbharā tato piva mahārāja sace tvaṃ {abhikaṃkhasīti}.
ja540:110.1: Sammuyhāmi pamuyhāmi, sabbā muyhanti medisā, petaṃ taṃ Sāma addakkhiṃ, ko nu tvaṃ Sāma jīvasīti.
ja540:111.1: Api jīvaṃ mahārāja purisaṃ gāḷhavedanaṃ upanītamanasakappaṃ jīvantaṃ maññate mataṃ.
ja540:112.1: Api jīvaṃ maharāja purisaṃ gāḷhavedanaṃ taṃ nirodhagataṃ santaṃ jīvantaṃ maññate matan ti.
ja540:113.1: Yo mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā macco dhammena posati devāpi naṃ tikicchanti mātāpettibharaṃ janaṃ.
ja540:114.1: Yo mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā macco dhammena posati idh' eva naṃ pasaṃsanti, pecca sagge ca modatīti.
ja540:115.1: Esa bhiyyo pamuyhāmi, sabbā muyhanti medisā, saraṇaṃ taṃ Sāma gacchāmi, tvañ ca me saraṇaṃ bhavā 'ti.
ja540:116.1: Dhammaṃ cara mahārāja mātāpitusu khattiya, (V. p. 123.) idha dhammaṃ caritvāna rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
ja540:117.1: Dhammaṃ cara mahārāja puttadāresu khattiya, (Sen. Mahāv. I p. idha dhammaṃ caritvāna rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
ja540:125.1: Dhammaṃ cara mahārāja saindadevā sabrahmakā suciṇṇena divaṃ pattā, mā dhammaṃ rāja pamādo ti.
